contract: Canonical dashboard_views.json owns user core tile membership/order/size and selected_view. Immutable presets retain existing overview layout; actual DashboardPage renders allowlisted original widget components for selected user views. PinnedTiles selection flows through reads, resolve, refresh, ledger and GenUI context. No parallel layout store.
acceptance: Persist selected user view and ordered supported core widget sizes in existing canonical view document with optimistic composition revision.
Presets immutable; stale writes/invalid refs reject; deleted selected view falls back to overview.
Original dashboard consumes user composition and original PinnedTiles targets selected view while preserving artifact overlays.
Actual HTTP/native and real DashboardPage component journey verify selection, reordering, size, refresh/remount and artifact isolation.

qualification.consumer_evidence: Actual ConsoleProviders, DashboardPage, useHashRoute and PinnedTiles against real HTTP verify selected core layout and selected-view-only artifact unpin.
